name: ember-theme
description: A warm, dark-only theme for long sessions: quiet warm-neutral surfaces, one ember-orange accent, and a faint ASCII field at the window's edges that glows while you focus with pomo. No blue anywhere.

backdrop.title: Ash field
backdrop.description: A faint scatter of ASCII glyphs along the edges of the window, which follows the pomo timer. Off gives a plain background.
